crossRefs.note: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against…
Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

people.name: Barabbas
people.line: A notorious prisoner released instead of Jesus.

translations.web: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
translations.bsb: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead.
translations.kjv: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
translations.asv: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
